start: Body screen, Progress photos, two or more photos saved

user_sees: Sheet titled 'Share before and after', 'Put two of your progress photos side by side in one picture.'; tiles 'Before' (first photo) and 'After' (latest) with their days
must_not: The newer photo shown as Before
Body weight or measurements on the picture

steps.action: Tap the 'Before' tile, then tap another photo in the row
user_sees: That photo takes the Before place; the older of the two stays Before
must_not: The picked photo going into the wrong place

steps.action: Pick Post or Story, Dark or See-through, Your gym Show or Hide, then tap Share picture
user_sees: The phone's share menu with one picture: both photos, their days, the gym's logo and name when Show
must_not: A picture sent anywhere before the member picks a target in the share menu

start: Body screen with fewer than two progress photos

steps.action: Look for Share before and after
user_sees: No sheet opens: BeforeAfterShare draws nothing without a pair (defaultPair gives null with fewer than two)
must_not: An empty sheet or a picture with one blank half

steps.action: Tap the photo that is already After
must_not: The newer photo left labelled Before (see FN-A5-phone-tracker-components-1-1-01)

steps.action: Close the sheet, delete one of the two photos, open the sheet again
user_sees: The pair starts again from the first and latest photo; the share-sized copies were deleted on close
must_not: A copy of the deleted photo left in the app cache

start: Sheet open with Your gym: Show

steps.action: Tap Share picture and pick WhatsApp
user_sees: Only the two photos, their days and the gym's name and logo leave the phone, and only through the share menu
must_not: Body weight, measurements or notes on the picture
Photos uploaded to MettleUp's server for the share
